text_block_list.text:
One day, Chairwoman Akikawa called out to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>'s performance was truly vivid! And full 
of promise!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! You have shown an outstanding 
performance that will serve as a goal for 
all the other Umamusume to aspire to!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I received words of praise in person...! 
Looks like I managed to get good results!
